concept: GTA 6 launch day as an arcade cabinet of our own, rendered in 3D (Blender): one locked camera, three states of the screen, so the carousel plays like a three-step animation (the one case where frames share a composition, see DESIGN.md). The screen carries every word in our own 5x7 dot lettering: GTA 6 is out today, loading 100%. So is half your team, out of office, eight little players and four gone dim. Your website isn't, still online, enquiries +3. A different button is lit each frame; the Nexulabs wordmark is the maker's badge under the screen. Near-black cabinet, warm white dots, one arcade green.
